sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2563 of 2023

Applicant :- Nitin Keshavji
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Raghubanshi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vivek Raghubanshi, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vivek Raghuvanshi and Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the learned A.G.A-I appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No. 528H of 2008, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 109 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow.

entities.text: F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No. 528H of 2008
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a F.I.R. lodged on 25.06.2008 against one Saurabh Mohan Srivastava, describing him as Managing Director of Tera Camp Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd., stating that the informant had deposited Rs. 50,000/- with the aforesaid person but that person ran away along with his family members.

entities.text: Tera Camp Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Nitin Keshavji vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has been implicated during investigating as he was one of the directors of the company.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case .
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R alleges depositing the amount with the person Jitendra Kumar Srivastava and not with the company of which he was the managing director and the F.I.R does not contain any allegation against the applicant and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8.
In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

Order Date :- 16.11.2023 Pradeep/-
